$description: Craft Your Money design tokens, in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. This file is an EXPORT of src/app/globals.css, not a second source: src/lib/tokens.test.ts fails if the two disagree. Values and roles come from docs/craft-your-money-design-system.md §1. Read by the live library at /design and by the Figma variables.

card.$description: The single framed surface only. Not for grouping.

ink.$description: All primary text and all numbers. Used at fixed opacities (see opacity.ink).

clay.$description: Identity accent: framing, top rules, the nav plus square.

clay-deep.$description: Actionable clay: links, buttons, active nav, verb-links, focus.

on-clay.$description: Text and icons on a clay-deep fill (primary button, the nav plus square, the send button). Warm off-white, not pure white, so it doesn't glare on clay.

iris.$description: The glint only. Appears only when the AI assistant is involved.

green.$description: Healthy. Chips only. Dark enough that chip text on its own 15% fill clears AA (4.5:1).

amber.$description: Caution. Chips only. Dark enough that chip text on its own 15% fill clears AA (4.5:1).

red.$description: Risky / loss. Chips only, plus the urgency stripe. Dark enough that chip text on its own 15% fill clears AA (4.5:1).

opacity.$description: Ink is never a set of greys: it is the one ink colour at fixed opacities. Tailwind writes these as text-ink/62, border-ink/14 and so on.

62.$description: Secondary labels, meta text, section labels (caps), inactive nav, unit suffixes. The lightest rung for text: 4.7:1 on page, so any size clears AA. Hierarchy below body copy comes from size, caps and tracking, not from a lighter ink.

30.$description: Placeholders, muted marks, the neutral stripe.

14.$description: Stronger dividers, input borders, dashed frames.

10.$description: The neutral chip's fill, and a disabled send button. A fill, never a line or text.

tint.$description: Tinted bands (briefing, insight strip): ink at 3.5%, deliberately lighter than any cream fill.

chip-fill.$description: A status chip's background: its status colour at 15%.

radius.$description: Seven named radii on the 2/4/8 scale (consolidated 2026-09-17 from 2 5 6 7 8 11 14). Nothing is rounder than 12px except chips and a sheet's top corners. Generous radii read as app cards, the thing this system avoids. rounded-full is geometry (a true circle or capsule), not a token.

stamp.$description: The workflow stamp (Draft, Archived); the nav's active indicator and thin bars.

input.$description: Text and money inputs; the type-to-search popover under one. Sharper than a button on purpose: a field, not an action.

button.$description: Buttons, dropdown and select triggers, action-sheet buttons. Also shadcn's --radius.

band.$description: Tinted bands, the framed surface, the edit shell, dashed containers, radio cards, the assistant slot, notes and small framed elements.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet (Drawer).

chip.$description: The chip family: status, filter, period and follow-up chips, badges. Text in a pill that reads as a chip.

space.$description: Spacing from §1.5 — one closed scale in three tiers, after Brad Frost's Eddie. scale: the steps, named by Tailwind index (p-1 = 4px); nothing between them exists. size: t-shirt aliases onto the steps, the vocabulary Figma and the spec speak. role: the relationship between two things on a screen (pt-section, gap-tight), each aliasing a size. nudge (2px) is the only sub-4pt step and never a rhythm; tap-target is 44px by WCAG, off the rhythm on purpose.

scale.$description: Tier 1. 4pt to 24, 8pt to 64, then 96 for a page's bottom clearance.

24.$description: A page's bottom clearance for a sticky footer or the nav.

size.$description: Tier 2. Reach for a size only when no role names the relationship.

xs.$description: Micro: inside a lockup, a label over its value.

sm.$description: Inline: an icon beside its label.

role.$description: Tier 2. What a screen actually says. A component never margins its own root (§1.5); these are for the container that arranges things.

tight.$description: Inside a lockup: an icon and its label, a label and its value.

row.$description: Vertical padding of a single-line row: sheet items, attention rows. A product row is min-h row-height with tight padding instead, so it lands on exactly 64px.

section.$description: Between blocks inside a zone; the top padding of a section.

tap-target.$description: Minimum touch target (WCAG 2.5.5). Deliberately off the rhythm.

nudge.$description: The only sub-4pt step, and never a rhythm: a currency glyph or decimals against their figure, a figure above its dashed underline, the sm chip's vertical inset.

serif.$description: Outputs and identity: product names, prices, all numbers, greetings, totals.

sans.$description: Everything else: labels, body, meta, buttons, navigation.

type.$description: Twenty-four presets on eleven sizes (§1.4, decided 2026-09-17): sizes on the 2pt grid, line boxes on 4pt so text stacks on the spacing rhythm. Named category-size; each carries size, line-height, weight and tracking, and is one Tailwind utility (text-meta, text-figure-lg) plus font-serif or font-sans. The r3 role names live in the descriptions.

figure-xl.$description: Your price, the final price in the pricing block. r3: final-price.

figure-lg.$description: Dashboard average profit; the editable price field. r3: hero-figure (46) and an unnamed 44.

figure-md.$description: Your profit, the last word of the pricing block. The one number allowed to carry its chip's colour. r3: profit.

figure-sm.$description: A total: what this costs to make; the business-costs total. r3: figure (and an unnamed 28).

title.$description: Greeting, product name on the detail header, screen titles. r3: title (27) and the 26px list titles.

name.$description: Product name in a list row; a material or step name. r3: row-name.

value.$description: A money value on a list row; input values. r3: row-value (15.5).

value-sm.$description: The total beside a section label, ink/62. r3: section-total (13).

prose.$description: The editorial voice on a surface made for reading: the Price Check verdict, the coach teaser. Lora, because the app opens like a message, not a report. r3: unnamed 16/1.35 and 16/1.4.

prose-sm.$description: The same voice as an aside among data: the dashboard briefing, ink/62. Quieter and smaller on purpose; the briefing concept itself is to be tested later. r3: briefing (15/1.55, misdocumented as Plex).

body.$description: Body and helper copy, the calm sentences under a figure. r3: body (13).

body-sm.$description: Quiet captions and sublabels, ink/62. r3: meta-light (11.5) and the unnamed 11px lights.

label.$description: A cost line's label, a settings row, a list option. r3: row-label (15) and the unnamed 14px regulars.

label-strong.$description: The assistant label (iris-deep), a radio card's title, the action sheet's cancel. r3: assistant (13.5).

link.$description: A verb-link, clay-deep: Reprice, + Add material. r3: verb-link (13.5).

button-ghost.$description: The ghost button; dropdown and filter triggers, because a dropdown is a ghost with a chevron. r3: button-ghost (14.5), dropdown (12.5).

meta.$description: A row's meta line, ink/62: 5g × £38.00/g. r3: meta.

chip.$description: Both chip sizes; sm is a tighter inset, not smaller type. 12 is the floor for chip text. r3: chip, chip-sm (10.5).

caps.$description: Section labels and the workflow stamp, ink/62. The system's quiet structural voice. r3: section-label, workflow-stamp (9.5/0.22em).

caps-tight.$description: Metric and field labels. r3: metric-label (9).

line.$description: Depth comes from lines, never from elevation. Colours are ink at an opacity, or the clay accent.

hairline.$description: Between subsections. No longer between rows in a list.

divider.$description: Before a summary, above a metric band, input borders.

accent-rule.$description: Historic top rule of the framed surface; today the price underline (2px).

urgency-stripe.$description: Inset, rounded, in the gutter of a list row. Status-coloured and urgency-scaled: red 100%, amber 55%, green 38%.

shadcn.$description: The shadcn/ui semantic tokens (:root in globals.css), mapped onto this palette so any shadcn primitive lands on-brand by default. Opacity tokens are baked to the nearest solid here because shadcn expects solids.

secondary.$description: A step below page. Not used by hand-skinned components.

muted-foreground.$description: ≈ ink at 62% on page, baked solid.

border.$description: ≈ ink at 14% on page, baked solid.
